description: This PHP source file defines the class TemplateHTML, a custom field type extending TemplateField, used in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment for rendering and managing HTML content within the system's UI and database schema.

classes.name: TemplateHTML
classes.description: A custom field class for handling HTML content in SuiteCRM, with methods for rendering HTML in various views and managing database alterations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sets the ext3 property to 'text' and calls the parent save method.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets default values based on ext4 property if available, then calls parent set method.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns an HTML div element with a title attribute and the field's name in uppercase.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing the field, currently the same as get_html_detail.

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Returns HTML for listing view, same as get_html_detail.

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Returns HTML for search view, same as get_html_detail.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Converts ext4 content into HTML with line breaks for detail display.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Returns content for editing, same as get_xtpl_detail.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns content for listing, same as get_xtpl_detail.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns content for search, same as get_xtpl_detail.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string; no additional SQL needed for adding this field.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string; no modification SQL needed.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string; no deletion SQL needed.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the database field definition array, merging default values such as ext4 if present, and setting properties like 'studio', 'source', and 'dbType'.
